svg.text: the route from central carbon to the measured lipids
fatty acid biosynthesis, elongation and desaturation
measured species drawn on this map
C16:1 palmitoleate, C18:0 stearate and C18:1 oleate are measured here
and have no node on the reference map. The map carries no labels of its
own: at this size they would print at about 2.5 pt.
